privateLessons.title: Paper mache sculpture, one to one
privateLessons.blurb: A four-session block where your child builds one sculpture from scratch — designed, built, painted and finished — working directly alongside a practising artist.
privateLessons.location: Kindness's studio, Bay Area (full address shared on booking)

steps.title: Design & armature
steps.body: We start with the idea — a creature, a character, something from imagination. Then we build the skeleton underneath it from wire, cardboard and foil. This is the part that decides whether the finished piece has real posture and life to it.

steps.title: Layering
steps.body: The paper mache goes on in overlapping layers, working around the form. Messy, satisfying, and the session where the sculpture stops being an idea and starts being an object. It then dries in the studio between visits.

steps.title: Shaping & detail
steps.body: Once dry, we sand it smooth and add the fine detail — teeth, scales, eyes, texture — using paper clay. Then a coat of primer so the colour will sit properly on the surface.

steps.title: Paint & seal
steps.body: Colour, layering and highlights, taught the way Kindness paints her own work. Finished with a protective seal so it lasts. The sculpture goes home the same day.

included: All materials — wire, paper, paste, paper clay, primer, paint and sealant
Use of Kindness's studio tools and workspace
Safe drying and storage of the piece between sessions
One completed, sealed sculpture to take home
Aprons provided (though old clothes are still wise)
